entities.name: Lynching of Dipu Chandra Das
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: On 18 December 2025, Dipu Chandra Das, a Hindu garment worker in Bhaluka, Bangladesh, was beaten, hanged from a tree, and set on fire, in a Hinduphobic hate crime by Islamists, after being accused of making derogatory remarks about Islam at a factory event. Investigators later reported that no evidence was found to support the allegation.
